name: Lehren
description: An old fisherman who sells fish at the market and owns the ship used for the sacrifice.

timeline.summary: Mia watches hooded villagers load sheep carcasses onto Lehren's ship and sees Wilbur among them.
timeline.quote: Wilbur gave one last lingering gaze into the woods before turning to board.

timeline.summary: Mia knocks out Lehren with her crossbow and confronts the hooded villagers as they toss carcasses overboard.
timeline.quote: dropped like a sack of potatoes

timeline.summary: Mia sets the ship afire and dives into the icy lake with Wilbur, swimming back to shore.
timeline.quote: She turned forward and without a pause dove into the icy water, dragging Wilbur with her.
